# LinuxNetwork.ir

> LinuxNetwork.ir is a modern, 100% client-side Linux network engineering, server setup, and kernel tuning toolbox. All calculations, configurations, cryptographic keypairs, and scripts are generated locally in the browser with zero backend telemetry or data collection.

LinuxNetwork provides high-performance Linux kernel tuning (TCP BBRv3, buffer optimization), automated multi-distribution setup shell scripts, secure Nginx reverse proxy generators, in-browser WireGuard VPN configurators, CIDR subnet calculators, and Linux NAT & firewall routing studios.

## Core Engineering Tools

- [Server Setup Script Generator](https://linuxnetwork.ir/?tool=setup): Interactive multi-distro Bash script generator for automated server provisioning, BBR acceleration, SSH hardening, Fail2ban, Docker installation, and Iranian mirror configuration.
- [Sysctl Kernel & TCP BBR Optimizer](https://linuxnetwork.ir/?tool=sysctl): Professional `/etc/sysctl.d/99-network-tuning.conf` tuning profiles optimized for high-concurrency web servers, proxies, gaming, and low-latency tunnels.
- [Nginx Reverse Proxy Builder](https://linuxnetwork.ir/?tool=nginx): Modular Nginx reverse proxy and virtual host generator with WebSocket upgrades, OWASP security headers, gzip/brotli compression, and Let's Encrypt SSL.
- [WireGuard Configurator](https://linuxnetwork.ir/?tool=wireguard): In-browser client-side Curve25519 keypair generation, `wg0.conf` server configuration, mobile QR codes, and firewall forwarding rules.
- [CIDR Subnet Calculator](https://linuxnetwork.ir/?tool=subnet): IPv4 network calculator with CIDR mask parsing, host ranges, wildcard masks, and ready-to-run `ip route` and `iptables` Linux commands.
- [Routing & NAT Studio](https://linuxnetwork.ir/?tool=routing): Advanced Linux network router designer for NAT gateways (internet sharing), Port Forwarding (DNAT and Hairpin NAT), Docker firewall isolation (`DOCKER-USER`), and Multi-WAN policy routing supporting dual `iptables` and modern `nftables` syntax.

## Shell Scripts & Automated Installers

- [Bash Setup Script (setup.sh)](https://linuxnetwork.ir/setup.sh): Production-ready one-liner automated setup script supporting Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, AlmaLinux, Rocky Linux, Fedora, and Alpine.
- [Standalone Offline HTML](https://linuxnetwork.ir/standalone.html): Fully self-contained, offline-compatible HTML version of the toolbox.

## Open Source & Community

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/SalarTaheri/LinuxNetwork): Official open-source repository licensed under the MIT License.
- [Sitemap](https://linuxnetwork.ir/sitemap.xml): Complete bilingual XML sitemap for search engines and crawlers.
